content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the existing logic in the insertion function, which failed to handle the scenario where an inactive element was reinserted into the red-black tree. Specifically, when re-adding an element after its deletion, the code erroneously did not select the next branch to inspect, leading to an infinite loop. This occurred because the checks for determining the position of the element did not properly account for inactive elements after deletion. The modification made in the patch added a condition to restrict checks for active elements only during the EEXIST case, thus preventing the infinite looping issue.
